# Pasta Vino

> Warm, informal Italian trattoria in Sandviken, Bergen (Stølegaten 15). Fresh pasta, quality ingredients and authentic Italian flavours, made from scratch every day.

- Address: Stølegaten 15, 5003 Bergen, Norway
- Phone: +47 400 38 157
- Opening hours: Monday–Thursday and Sunday 15:00–21:30, Friday–Saturday 15:00–22:30
- Cuisine: Italian
- Rating: 4.6 (65 reviews)
